summary: Verified bug-fix: Contact form submits successfully with success toast and clears fields; empty submission shows validation toast (no 'Something went wrong'). Admin /admin page loads without any TypeError, renders stat cards and enquiries table, search + all 5 status filters work, row click opens dialog, status dropdown updates row, delete removes row. Zero JS/console errors during full flow. All 11 backend pytest cases pass (POST /api/contact, GET messages array, GET stats object, PATCH, DELETE, validation).
critical_code_review_comments: api.js falls back to relative '/api' when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is missing — good for dev but on Vercel this silently sends requests to the same origin (which has no backend). Consider surfacing a build-time warning or a runtime toast when the env var is empty to catch the production misconfig that caused the reported bug.
Admin.jsx does not paginate — .to_list(1000) in backend caps at 1000; fine for MVP but note the ceiling.
server.py CORS uses '*' default with allow_credentials=True — browsers will refuse credentials + wildcard. Consider setting explicit CORS_ORIGINS in prod.
seed_data_creation: Created a couple TEST_ contact messages via UI/API during flow; all cleaned up (delete tested + fixtures teardown).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview backend is healthy. Fixes in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js (asArray/asObject normalizers + .catch fallbacks) and Admin.jsx (Array.isArray guards) fully resolve the reported production bugs in the preview environment. Production Vercel issue was env-var (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) misconfig — out of scope.
